claim.claim_context: SYNTHETIC illustration — not a real scientific or medical conclusion.
claim.claim_text: People who drink herbal tea live longer, so herbal tea extends lifespan.

evidence_items.text: Cross-sectional survey shows tea drinkers have longer average lifespan.

detected.rationale: A causal 'extends lifespan' is drawn from a cross-sectional association.
No mechanism or controlled design links tea to lifespan.

reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That drinking tea will make them live longer.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Readers may adopt a habit expecting a causal benefit.
reader_impact.risk_uncertainty: Confounders (wealth, diet) plausibly drive the association.

recommended_revision.defensible_rewrite: In a cross-sectional survey, herbal-tea drinkers had a longer average lifespan; this association may reflect confounders rather than a causal effect.
recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: States association, not causation, and flags confounding.
